event: US jobless claims today 15:30 SAST. Cisco and Applied Materials report after the US close. Fed's Daly speaks about 20:10 SAST (time UNVERIFIED). US PPI Fri 13 Nov, 15:30 SAST.

bullets.title: Nvidia board crisis
bullets.text: Nvidia fell about 6-7% before the open as its board weighs removing CEO Jensen Huang, and no decision has been announced yet (Reuters, Yahoo Finance).

bullets.title: Nasdaq leads lower
bullets.text: Nasdaq 100 futures were down 0.63% at 12:26 SAST, against 0.31% for S&P 500 futures, while Dow futures were slightly up (TipRanks).

bullets.title: Chips are split
bullets.text: AMD rose 3.9% and Broadcom 3% before the open, while CoreWeave, Intel, Marvell and Micron fell (CNBC, Reuters).

bullets.title: Yields at 5%
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield rose to about 5.01% as bond trading reopened after Veterans Day, which weighs on tech valuations (CNBC).

bullets.title: Fed hike bets
bullets.text: After the hot October CPI, rate futures almost fully price a Fed hike in December, with a small chance of a 50 bp move (TradingKey).

bullets.title: Strong dollar
bullets.text: The dollar index rose above 103, its highest level since April 2025, on the same Fed hike bets (Reuters).

bullets.title: Earnings ahead
bullets.text: Cisco and Applied Materials report after today's close, and Nvidia reports on 17 November (ApexVol, TokenPost).
